name: IPCC
body: DMARC quarantines spoofed mail, framing is limited, and the start page reads well without JavaScript. But its <html> tag has no lang attribute, so screen readers guess the voice and browsers guess the translation.
lesson: Add lang="en" to the html tag, and the matching code on each translated page.
summary: www.ipcc.ch scores 69 out of 100 (D). 3 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 24 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 24 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /about/, /data/, /documentation/ and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The start page does not declare its language
fix.evidence: Screen readers pick the wrong voice and browsers offer the wrong translation.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: ipcc_PHPSESSID. Without HttpOnly: ipcc_PHPSESSID. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /about/, /data/ and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /about/, /data/, /documentation/ and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
